<thought>We have retrieved polymorphs for five oxide compositions and listed their JSON files. To continue building the dataset, I will retrieve polymorphs for the next five oxide compositions (ZnO, MgO, CaO, SrO, BaO) using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with the required filters (max_energy_above_hull = 0.3, max_per_composition = 3) and save them to the existing “oxides_data” directory.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": ["ZnO", "MgO", "CaO", "SrO", "BaO"],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "oxides_data"
}</action_input>
